title: Ender Wyrm
summary: The final boss. How it is summoned today, its three phases and every attack, Void Echoes, its rewards and what is still to come.

s.x: The
Ender Wyrm

is SkyRPG's final boss: a long serpentine dragon that circles above its arena, dives at you, breathes void fire, calls Void Echoes and, in its last phase, brings down a storm of void bolts. It is the hardest fight in the game, and the most generous.
Not fully in the game yet.
The Wyrm itself is finished, but the
altar
that players would build to summon it is not. Right now it can only be started by an admin (
/wyrm summon
) or with a spawn egg in creative mode. The Wyrmscale armour and the Voidreaver sword it is meant to drop are not made yet.
The plan is an
Ender Wyrm Altar
in the End, built from
Astral Shard
and one of each dungeon trophy, after the dragon is dead. None of that is in the game yet. Until then:
An op uses
/wyrm summon
, and the Wyrm appears 28 blocks away and 18 blocks up, circling the spot where the command was used. That spot becomes the
arena centre
Only one Wyrm can be alive in a dimension at a time.
/wyrm kill
removes any.
The Ender Wyrm quest, from Hollis Barrowmead in Skyhaven, asks you to "Defeat 1 Ender Wyrm" and pays 25,000 coins, 2,000 XP and 16 golden apples. It unlocks after the Astral Observatory quest.

rows.x: 1,024 base, with half damage taken beyond that, so about 2,000 effective
A long head and 12 body segments, about 18 blocks end to end

s.x: The Wyrm flies through blocks, so it cannot be hidden from by building. For the first 2 seconds after it appears it cannot be hurt. It only targets non-creative, non-spectator players within 100 blocks of the arena centre, and its boss bar shows to everyone within 160 blocks.
The Wyrm is always in one of a few states, and every attack is
telegraphed

by particles and a sound before it lands. Between attacks it circles the arena at about 18 blocks above the centre at a radius of 28 blocks (24 in phase 3). When its circling wait is up (6 seconds in phase 1, 4.5 in phase 2, 3.5 in phase 3), it picks the next attack.

s.x: At each phase change it roars, sends out rings, and
summons Void Echoes immediately

rows.x: A line of soul fire from its mouth to you, and a ring on the ground around you. It rears for 1.5 seconds (1.1 in phase 3), then dives along the line.
Hits for its full attack and throws you up. Hits each player once per dive. Chains 1, 2 or 3 dives by phase.
It hovers 17 blocks away, opens its jaws and gathers void light for 2.1 seconds (1.5 in phase 3) while the cone's edges are drawn in soul fire.

A cone of void breath 26 blocks long and 34 degrees wide, which slowly tracks you for 2.75 seconds (3.5 in phase 3). Each pulse (every quarter second) deals 30% of its attack and applies Wither II. Clouds linger where it hits the ground.
It rises over the arena while rings grow on the ground for 2.5 seconds.
3 Echoes (4 from phase 2) step out of the rings, 6 to 12 blocks from you.
A warning in chat ("The sky above the arena begins to split...") and 3 seconds of rising rings.
For about 8.5 seconds, void bolts fall at each player's position every 0.4 seconds, plus random bolts around the arena. Each is marked with a ring on the ground for a second before it strikes.

s.x: The attack choice at each decision is random, weighted by what is off cooldown:
In phase 3, if the storm is ready, there is a 50% chance of it.
If a summon is ready and few Echoes are alive, a 50% chance of that.
Otherwise 40% breath, 60% a dive chain.
Echo summons have a cooldown of 25, 20 and 16 seconds by phase, and the storm has a cooldown of about 50 seconds.
Void Echoes are named, purple endermen:
100 health, 12 damage, level 70.
They are persistent and hunt the player the Wyrm picked.
The Wyrm only summons more when few are left: none alive in phase 1, at most 1 in phases 2 and 3.
They disappear when the Wyrm dies.
Clear the Echoes quickly: more than one at a time cuts into the space you have to dodge dives, and the breath cone punishes standing still. Stay away from the soul-fire line the moment you see it.
The void storm's bolts are marked on the ground first. Keep moving sideways, and do not stand in a ring.

s.x: When it dies, each player who hurt it gets a ranking ("#1 ... damage to the Ender Wyrm") with their damage.
Wyrm Scales and Void Hearts have
no recipes or sell prices yet
. They are the materials for the planned end-game gear.
The Ender Wyrm Altar and its recipe.
The
Wyrmscale
armour set and the
Voidreaver
sword, made from the Wyrm's drops.
Until then, ask the staff if you want to try the fight.
